english.notes: (i) This offence has been split to provide a separate offence wording for each subsection covered in this document. See EP90023 in relation to subsection (1), EP90136 in relation to subsection (1A), EP90137 in relation to subsection (2A), and EP90138 in relation to subsection (5).

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
